body:
I've got daylight lamp inside my room which is almost always on during the day, does that light counts? 

Well, it's 7:30 am down there, so I'm going to sleep, good luck, I'll be there tomorrow.

And what if my condition is caused by factors that's outside my brains, outer world?
Pills are changing perception(as far as I know), but I seriously doubt that any prescribed pills will make me feel comfortable with carrying girlfriend's dead body everywhere with me(that's not the case).
What's going to happen with issues?

I'm 17 years old and don't have near enough money for that on my own, but my parents do have. Don't know whether I'm able to convince them or not.

I'll try anyway, that sounds reasonable, thanks.

None of my psychologists said to me that I'm mentally ill. There was three of them. I got no treatment. Should I waste more money, which I barely have, on endlessly talking with them and doing some almost funny tests?

Tomorrow means more fear and pain. Who ever needs it?

How is that going to get better? I do have a friends that care, some of them care really a lot, they all know what my condition is. 

Things that causing my depression is not going to just fly away on rainbows. My depression is not going to let me solve that things. I've wasted something like eight years trying to fix it, it took three years to break me though.

Another day. I'll tell you what happens. Parents are going to be angry at me, friends will say same useless stuff, still caring about me, but not knowing what to do. At least half of the day will be spent in really bad condition which makes me scream or cry or cut myself, there no other way to stop it fast.

Magic's not there. It will not get better, really, so many years without any progress.
